title: Catch-up spool controller owes the verdict keystone that replaced fn-cu-step-installs-only-through-the-verdict: every :local effect of fn-csp-step is the IHAVE of the record the round then offers, or a body window only after the local 335 to that IHAVE (then its terminator), and every :journal effect is the committed cursor of a batch with nothing left to offer. Witnessed by *cut-round* and *cut-round-435* in tests/acl2/peer-catchup-tests.lisp, not proved.
